# S360 — Local roles: a smaller fixed context

*Proposed.* Owner decision 2026-11-12 (relay session 8d711f67, chat: "4 yes for local"): a local role starts with less fixed context. ork turns off the tools and commands the role never uses and caps long command output. Cloud roles do not change.

**Findings:** S304 trial 1 (2026-11-11): the claude-local implementer's first turn already held about 22k tokens before it read any file; long command output (go test) also fills the window. · **Size:** S · **Tree:**

**2026-11-12** — Verified: claude-local roles get --disallowedTools WebFetch,WebSearch,Task,Agent,NotebookEdit,Skill and --disable-slash-commands before --allowedTools; a UI pass drops Skill from the list and omits --disable-slash-commands; cloud argv is unchanged (TestArgsLocalWriteRoleTurnsOffUnusedTools, TestArgsLocalReadOnlyUsesAllowlist, TestArgsLocalUIPassKeepsSkill, TestArgsCloudRoleUnchanged, TestClaudeReadOnlyRoleArguments; each mutation-checked). claudeEnv sets BASH_MAX_OUTPUT_LENGTH=10000 for claude-local only and replaces an inherited value (TestClaudeLocalEnvCapsBashOutput). Output-cap measurement (owner, 2026-11-12, claude 2.1.322, cloud haiku; the cap is client-side): unset, a seq 1 4000 output (18.9 KB) reached the model whole; with BASH_MAX_OUTPUT_LENGTH=2000 it became a persisted-output notice (Output too large, 18.5KB, full output saved to a file) plus a ~2.2 KB preview; unset, a 106 KB output was already persisted with a ~2.2 KB preview. Owner kept 10000. Not measured: the first-turn input tokens before and after on a fake brief (no local model server in the implementer sandbox). go test ./... green, go vet and gofmt clean.

## Why

*Proposed.* Every token of fixed context is prefilled on the local server on each turn and counts toward the compaction threshold. claude CLI 2.1.322 has `--disallowedTools` and `--disable-slash-commands` (`claude --help`). Tools a relay role does not use: WebFetch, WebSearch, Task/Agent, NotebookEdit, Skill (a UI pass on a local launcher keeps Skill, since its brief names skills: `internal/engine/brief.go:103`). The implementer checks the current tool names in `claude --help` and the stream's `init` event before listing them.
